title: tpsrca_report
description: Placeholder contract of templates/assets/tpsrca-report.html - the primary HTML of the TPSRCA assessment pack (html + risk-register xlsx + gap-tracker xlsx + executive-brief pptx + evidence zip). The tpsrca-assessment-engine agent fills these {{PLACEHOLDERS}} from its own 12-agent output (claude-account-export/skills/tpsrca-assessment-engine/references/output_schema.json); the section ids of the template map 1:1 to that schema's top-level keys. The template is not yet approved (registry last_approved: null) and its renderer/pipeline are pending, so this contract governs the template-manager preview today and the multi-file renderer when it lands.

APPROVAL_STATUS.description: composite_score.approval_status; any conditional approval must be justified in ROWS_RECOMMENDATIONS.

CLASSIFICATION_TIER.description: metadata.classification_tier from the engine (supplier tiering, not the document label).

CRITICAL_RISKS_COUNT.description: Integer as a string - written straight into the KPI tile.

FRAMEWORK_AXIS_LABELS.description: Pipe-separated framework names (Agent 7 framework_scores.frameworks). Must have the same count as FRAMEWORK_SCORES.

FRAMEWORK_SCORES.description: Pipe-separated compliance percentages (0-100), same order and count as FRAMEWORK_AXIS_LABELS - the chart silently skips a mismatch.

GAPS_COUNT.description: Integer as a string - written straight into the KPI tile.

HIGH_RISKS_COUNT.description: Integer as a string - written straight into the KPI tile.

OVERALL_EFFECTIVENESS.description: Agent 5 control_effectiveness summary, e.g. '72% effective (Partially Effective)'.

PPTX_BRIEF_NAME.description: File name of the companion deliverable in the assessment pack, as stored in SharePoint Reports/<Supplier>/<Service>/.

PRIORITY_ACTIONS_COUNT.description: Integer as a string - written straight into the KPI tile.

ROWS_CALCULATIONS.description: Pre-rendered <tr>...</tr> rows for the matching engine section (section ids map 1:1 to the top-level keys of the engine's references/output_schema.json). HTML entities only for glyphs; no <script> and no external references.
